MATERIAL MAXIMALITY REVISION. First strengthen the collision result. Replace the hard-wired eta_N=N^{-1/4}, zeta_N=N^{-1} by the underlying two-parameter positive family C(eta,zeta). For all sufficiently small eta,zeta>0 prove both members lie in M^HL_{3,5} (zeta>0 gives three distinct binary emission profiles), one-panel KL=O(zeta^2), sigma_3(V_D)=Theta(zeta) with coefficient 6250/(17 sqrt(1266)) along eta->0, and Delta(eta,zeta)=63 eta/544+O(eta^2+zeta). Deduce for N zeta_N^2->0 and zeta_N=o(eta_N), with eta_N->0 or eta_N identically a sufficiently small fixed eta_0>0, that product laws merge while the ATT gap is respectively (63/544+o(1))eta_N or tends to the nonzero Delta(eta_0,0). Retain the N^{-1/4} statement as a corollary and add the stronger corollary: no estimator is uniformly consistent and no uniformly honest band has o(1) diameter over the full unseparated M^HL_{3,5} neighborhood. Scope this to the displayed family and do not claim any comparator theorem is contradicted. Equations (33)–(44) in the discharged proof contain the needed uniform KL and bivariate target formula; do not add a rate OEQ because without hazard/emission-splitting coupling the class has no nontrivial uniform rate. Sync tldr, technical_internal_limitation, honest_scope, gap/niche/fill, and related_work.

Second correct the Weiss–Nadler scope and legal-frontier geometry. State Weiss–Nadler is an algebraic ancestor, not a containing model: it treats an ordinary all-length stationary parametric-output HMM with exactly two aliased states, A1 output-family linear independence of order n, and A2 ergodic transition/positive stationary law. This stopped two-terminal model allows arbitrary alpha; its binary K=3 instance cannot satisfy A1 because three binary pmfs lie in a two-dimensional function space. Neither class contains the other and no converse transfers. State thm:generic-converse directly on the fixed-emission-partition stratum of M^stop_{K,T}, replacing “within the aliased model.” In def:legal-frontier-handle retain the full two-dimensional alias-block centralizer S(a,b)=((a,1-a),(b,1-b)), a!=b. For unequal hazards the map (a,b) -> S(a,b) diag(S(a,b)^{-1}h) S(a,b)^{-1} is generically two-dimensional, with a Jacobian minor -(h_1-h_2)^2/(a-b)^4; positivity inequalities do not reduce local dimension. Replace predeclared branchwise univariate numerator tests by bivariate rational constancy tests on the positive legal region, allowing reduction to univariate sign problems only after a proof. Do not import connectedness from Weiss–Nadler because the transformed-hazard and de-killed-transition legality constraints define a different region. Keep oeq:legal-lift-frontier genuinely open for an explicit invariant list and complete component enumeration; the existing one-parameter path proves the generic converse but not the complete fiber. Retain project_justification.fill wording that explicitly calls this frontier an open question.
